title: Game Settings
description: Global game balance configuration for NewWorldOrder

growth_rate_gdp_modifier.description: GDP per capita contribution to growth rate

migration_pull_threshold.description: Development level difference threshold to trigger migration (0-1)

unrest_poverty_threshold.description: GDP per capita below which unrest grows (thousands USD)

unrest_growth_per_month.description: Maximum unrest increase per month when below poverty threshold

unrest_decay_rate.description: Base unrest decay rate per month from social spending

education_growth_rate.description: Monthly education level increase from spending

healthcare_growth_rate.description: Monthly healthcare access increase from social spending

literacy_growth_rate.description: Monthly literacy increase rate (tracks education with lag)

fertility_base.description: Baseline fertility rate (children per woman, replacement ~2.1)

fertility_education_modifier.description: Education impact on fertility (negative = reduces fertility)

life_expectancy_healthcare_modifier.description: Maximum years added by healthcare access (0-1 healthcare → 0-N years)

unrest_natural_decay_rate.description: Base unrest decay per month regardless of social spending (prevents irreversibility)

migration_international_rate.description: Fraction of border province population that can migrate internationally per month

refugee_unrest_threshold.description: Province unrest above which international outflow triggers

max_migration_pct.description: Maximum fraction of a source province's population that can emigrate per month (aggregate outflow budget)

max_migration_inflow_pct.description: Maximum fraction of a destination province's population that can immigrate per month (aggregate inflow cap; bounds concentration)

max_monthly_growth_pct.description: Maximum magnitude of monthly natural population growth rate (correctness bound, not a post-hoc clamp)

max_province_population.description: Absolute sanity ceiling on a single province's population. Not the primary runaway control (per-month percentage bounds in the growth/migration systems are); this is a final defensive clamp.

max_construction_queue_per_province.description: Maximum simultaneous construction slots per province

max_concurrent_constructions_per_country.description: Hard cap on total active ConstructionSlots across all provinces owned by a country. Prevents the maintenance cliff when hundreds of buildings finish simultaneously.

upkeep_warning_surplus_fraction.description: UI-only warning threshold: warn the player when projected additional monthly building upkeep (queued constructions + the candidate building) exceeds this fraction of the country's current monthly surplus. Never blocks the build.

construction_cost_multiplier.description: Global construction cost scaling (1.0 = normal, for difficulty)

infrastructure_construction_bonus.description: Extra construction progress per infrastructure point

max_buildings_per_province.description: Hard cap on total completed + under-construction buildings per province

demolish_refund_pct.description: Fraction of construction cost refunded when demolishing (0-1)

construction_progress_base.description: Base construction progress per tick (1 month = 1.0)

infrastructure_progress_bonus.description: Extra progress per infrastructure point (infra 100 → +50% at 0.005)

base_building_slots.description: Minimum building slots per province regardless of infrastructure

infra_slot_threshold.description: Infrastructure points required per extra building slot above base

small_nation_province_threshold.description: Owned-province count at/below which a nation gets the small-nation building-slot bonus (extra base slots + faster infra unlock). 0 disables the bonus.

small_nation_bonus_slots.description: Extra base building slots per province granted to small nations.

small_nation_infra_threshold_scale.description: Multiplier on the infra→slot threshold for small nations (<1 unlocks slots faster).

province_size_weight_enabled.description: Scale the flat additive building research_output lane by baked province size relative to the world-average province, correcting the ADM1/ADM2 admin-granularity imbalance. Trade bonuses stay unweighted (already country-capped at 0.50/0.25); GDP/resource lanes stay unweighted (already size-fair) as do defense and province-local effects.

province_size_weight_gdp_blend.description: Share of the size weight taken from baked base production vs baked population (0 = population only, 1 = base production only).

province_size_weight_exponent.description: Exponent applied to the raw size ratio before clamping. 1.0 = linear (country weight sums are granularity-neutral away from the clamps); <1 compresses mega-provinces but re-inflates province-count-heavy countries.

province_size_weight_min.description: Clamp floor on the province size weight. Keeps micro-province buildings marginally useful without letting huge ADM2 rosters (UK 232, Malta 68 provinces) stack floored output.

province_size_weight_max.description: Clamp ceiling on the province size weight. Stops mega-provinces (Punjab, Uttar Pradesh) from becoming single-province superlabs.

max_infrastructure.description: Hard cap on province infrastructure. Must be a multiple of infra_slot_threshold for clean slot progression.

passive_infrastructure_cap.description: Ceiling on infrastructure funded by the national infrastructure budget alone. Budget spending stops contributing to a province at this level; only infrastructure BUILDINGS can push it from here up to max_infrastructure. A province with no infrastructure-providing buildings is also clamped back down to this level. Must be <= max_infrastructure. Deliberately NOT a multiple of infra_slot_threshold at the shipped value of 150: it sits just below the 160 slot threshold, so a purely budget-funded province stops at 6 slots and can see that the 7th requires an actual infrastructure building. Set it equal to max_infrastructure to disable the passive ceiling entirely.

passive_infrastructure_reference_spendin.description: Actual monthly infrastructure spending as a GDP fraction that produces the reference annual passive infrastructure growth rate. 0.00375 corresponds to 18% of monthly revenue at a 25% tax rate.

passive_infrastructure_reference_annual_.description: Annual passive infrastructure growth per eligible province at the reference spending ratio.

passive_infrastructure_spending_exponent.description: Response exponent for actual infrastructure spending relative to the reference ratio. Values above 1 make heavy investment progressively more effective until the annual cap.

passive_infrastructure_max_annual_growth.description: Maximum annual passive infrastructure growth per eligible province, regardless of additional national infrastructure spending.

base_queue_slots.description: Minimum concurrent construction queue slots per province

dev_queue_threshold.description: Development level points required per extra queue slot above base

building_dev_growth_rate.description: DevLevel points gained per completed building per month

infra_dev_growth_rate.description: Max monthly DevLevel growth from infrastructure (at infra=100)

level_stacking_decay.description: Diminishing returns weight for stacking same-type buildings in a province. weight(i)=1/(1+decay*i). 0 = no penalty, 0.5 = 2nd≈0.67×, 3rd≈0.5×.

province_production_modifier_cap.description: Hard cap on the per-province GDP modifier from buildings. 0 disables the cap. 1.5 = +150% max.

repeat_cost_factor.description: Per-extra-instance cost surcharge for repeat builds of the same type in a province. cost = base × (1 + factor × existingCount). Anti-spam.

maintenance_level_scaling_exponent.description: Super-linear maintenance per level. effective = base × pow(level, exponent). 1 = legacy linear, 1.3 = upgrades cost noticeably more.

manpower_per_regiment.description: Real-world personnel per 1 in-game regiment (EU4-style scaling)

monthly_manpower_regen_rate.description: Monthly fraction of reserve manpower converted to active personnel

monthly_manpower_regen_min.description: Minimum monthly manpower regenerated when reserve is available

contract_soldiers.description: Bounded money->manpower path (professional/foreign enlistment, UAE/Qatar-style). Lets a rich small state field an expeditionary force capped by a fraction of its native pool.

cost_per_manpower_usd.description: One-time treasury cost per contracted manpower point (recruit + train).

upkeep_per_manpower_usd_month.description: Monthly treasury upkeep per active contracted manpower point. 0 disables upkeep.

max_fraction_of_base_pool.description: Contract-force ceiling as a fraction of the native (bake-time) Manpower+Reserve pool. 1.0 = can at most double it.

monthly_pace_fraction.description: Fraction of the contract ceiling recruitable per month (pace limit).

military_tick_interval.description: Military systems run every N economy ticks (1 = every tick)

transport_troops_per_ship.description: Soldiers lifted per transport_capacity slot (a carrier's 4 slots move 4x this).

transport_max_pooled_fleets.description: Max fleets the auto-transport planner pools into one convoy for a single army lift.

transport_prefer_land_max_hops.description: Land paths up to this many province hops always march overland instead of offering sea transport (0 disables the preference).

naval_queue_slots_per_province.description: Concurrent fleet construction slots per province (replaces the former per-country cap).

air_queue_slots_per_province.description: Concurrent air wing construction slots per province (replaces the former per-country cap).

template_rally_max_hops.description: Max province hops between an army-template build province and its rally point.

template_rally_timeout_ticks.description: Ticks a rally order survives while its rally point stays unreachable, before expiring.

template_rank_hop_weight.description: Template distribution: penalty weight per province hop from the rally point.

template_rank_infra_weight.description: Template distribution: score weight per point of province infrastructure.

template_rank_spread_penalty.description: Template distribution: penalty per unit already assigned to a province (drives the spread).

chase_retarget_interval_ticks.description: How often (military ticks) a chasing army/fleet re-checks its pursued target's province and re-routes. Higher = cheaper but slower reaction.

chase_max_consecutive_failures.description: Consecutive blocked/stalled chase evaluations before a pursuit order breaks off and the chaser halts (mirrors route-maintenance repath failure policy).

combat_width_base.description: Minimum combat width (units that can fight simultaneously)

combat_width_infra_factor.description: Infrastructure contribution to combat width (infra × factor)

morale_casualty_penalty.description: Morale lost per % casualties this tick

morale_winning_bonus.description: Morale gained per tick when winning combat

morale_losing_penalty.description: Morale lost per tick when losing combat

morale_retreat_threshold.description: Army retreats when morale drops below this

army_idle_morale_recovery_per_tick.description: Morale recovered per military tick for idle armies (not in combat, siege, occupation, or transport)

army_idle_hp_recovery_per_tick.description: HP recovered per military tick for idle armies (not in combat, siege, occupation, or transport). Draws from country ReservePersonnel.

army_hp_recovery_garrison_bonus.description: Fractional bonus applied to HP recovery when army is in owned territory (0.5 = +50% faster recovery in garrison)

army_hp_recovery_manpower_per_hp.description: ReservePersonnel consumed per HP recovered per regiment. Set to 0 to disable manpower cost for healing.

occupation_unrest.description: Unrest added to province when captured

attacker_return_fire_multiplier.description: Damage multiplier applied to return fire on attackers (< 1.0 favors attacker)

air_superiority_ground_bonus.description: Ground attack bonus from full air superiority (0-1 fraction)

unit_creation_cost_multiplier.description: Global multiplier for unit creation costs

unit_maintenance_multiplier.description: Global multiplier for unit maintenance costs

creation_progress_base.description: Base unit creation progress per tick

creation_infra_bonus.description: Extra creation progress per infrastructure point

garrison_per_1k_pop.description: Garrison units required per 1,000 population to maintain occupation

occupation_attrition_rate.description: Monthly HP/morale attrition rate on garrison from resistance (0-1)

devastation_from_combat.description: Devastation added per tick of active combat in a province

devastation_decay_rate.description: Monthly devastation decay rate (absolute points per tick)

resistance_growth_rate.description: Monthly resistance growth rate in occupied provinces

transfer_resistance_base.description: Initial resistance level when province is transferred in peace deal

transfer_resistance_decay_months.description: Months for transfer-resistance to fully decay

siege_defense_base.description: Base defense points each province has at siege start (before pop/infra modifiers)

siege_defense_per_1k_pop.description: Extra defense points per 1,000 province population

siege_defense_infra_factor.description: Extra defense points per infrastructure level

siege_damage_per_unit.description: Base siege damage contributed by one attacker unit per military tick

siege_min_damage_per_tick.description: Minimum siege damage per tick so progress never fully stalls

siege_recovery_rate_per_tick.description: Fraction of SiegeDefenseMax recovered per tick when no siege force is present

siege_attacker_morale_drain_base.description: Morale lost by besieging armies each military tick (supply strain, fatigue)

siege_attacker_morale_drain_fort_multipl.description: Scales extra morale drain with province fortification level (higher = forts are more demoralising)

siege_attacker_attrition_per_tick.description: Fraction of attacker unit count lost per military tick from sniper fire / IEDs during siege

infrastructure_gdp_multiplier.description: How much each unit of infrastructure boosts GDP

inflation_gdp_penalty_per_percent.description: GDP growth penalty factor applied to fraction-scale inflation (e.g. 0.1 means 5% inflation causes 0.005 growth penalty)

base_tax_rate.description: Default tax rate for new countries (0-1)

resource_surplus_export_ratio.description: Fraction of surplus that gets exported

resource_deficit_import_ratio.description: Fraction of deficit that gets imported

per_capita_resource_demand.description: Resource units consumed per person per month

trade_balance_growth_cap.description: Absolute annual clamp for trade-balance contribution to GDP growth (0.03 = +/-3%)

inflation_sensitivity.description: How responsive inflation is to spending/GDP ratio

inflation_min.description: Minimum inflation rate as fraction (e.g. -0.05 = -5% deflation)

province_gdp_reconciliation_strength.description: Damping on the internal (organic) province-signal delta before it moves country GDP. 1.0 applies it in full.

province_gdp_signal_scale_min.description: Lower clamp on the per-country province-signal-to-GDP calibration. Also the system's memory of what a collapsed country used to be worth, so the GDP re-anchor has a target to converge to.

province_gdp_signal_scale_max.description: Upper clamp on the per-country province-signal-to-GDP calibration.

province_reconciliation_max_monthly_delt.description: Anti-spike cap on the internal reconciliation delta as a fraction of country GDP. 0.0005 = ±0.05%/month. 0 disables the cap.

province_gdp_reanchor_monthly_rate.description: Fraction of the shortfall below (engage_ratio × calibrated territory value) that country GDP recovers per month. 0.06 = half the gap in ~11 months, 95% in ~4 years. 0 disables the re-anchor.

province_gdp_reanchor_engage_ratio.description: The GDP re-anchor engages only below this fraction of the calibrated value of a country's owned territory, and converges to exactly that line. 0.75 leaves a 25% deadband so normal drift is ignored.

default_budget.description: Default budget allocation percentages (must sum to 1.0)

gdp_diminishing_reference_usd.description: GDP reference point for diminishing returns calculation (USD). Economies above this see slower growth.

gdp_diminishing_exponent.description: Power-law exponent for GDP diminishing returns (lower = weaker effect).

base_annual_interest_rate.description: Annual interest rate on national debt (fraction, e.g. 0.04 = 4%)

high_debt_interest_premium.description: Additional annual interest rate when debt-to-GDP exceeds 1.0 (fraction)

price_shock_decay_rate.description: Realism pass: monthly decay of resource price-shock multipliers toward 1.0 (0.25 = 25%/mo)

price_shock_max_multiplier.description: Realism pass: upper clamp on the additive oil/food/global price-shock multiplier stack

demand_price_elasticity.description: Realism pass: demand destruction — consumption × clamp(1 - e·(mult-1), minFactor, 1)

demand_elasticity_min_factor.description: Realism pass: floor on the demand-elasticity factor (necessities)

supply_price_elasticity.description: Realism pass: supply response — output × clamp(1 + e·(mult-1), 1, maxFactor)

supply_elasticity_max_factor.description: Realism pass: ceiling on the supply-response factor (short-run max output rise)

ai_deficit_tax_response.description: Realism pass: AI fiscal discipline — fraction of the structural deficit gap converted to tax-toward-ceiling

ai_deficit_ratio_trigger.description: Realism pass: structural-deficit trigger as a fraction of monthly revenue

ai_high_debt_ratio_trigger.description: Realism pass: high-debt trigger (DebtToGDPRatio) for AI fiscal discipline / austerity

ai_fiscal_reserve_shift_max.description: Realism pass: max discretionary→reserve reallocation per fiscal-discipline pass

debt_anchor_drift_floor_fraction.description: Fraction of a country's AnchorDebtRatio that its debt may be paid down to. Both paydown paths floor here. Shipped at 1.0: debt holds at its structural level and only moves when a country runs deficits. Values below 1.0 do NOT create fiscal drift — the paydown is fast enough that solvent countries all park on the floor, so it acts as a flat haircut on the curated real-world ratios (at 0.6, 169 of 217 countries sat at exactly 0.6x anchor and Japan read 151% against its true 251%).

max_debt_ratio.description: Maximum debt-to-GDP ratio before forced stabilization

tier_growth_bonus.description: Additional annual GDP growth rate by development tier (convergence mechanic)

trade_agreement_defaults.description: Default term sheet for new bilateral trade agreements when caller passes none, plus global stacking caps. Mirrors trade_agreement.schema.json plus engine-wide caps.

bilateral_growth_bonus_cap_annual.description: Hard cap on summed BilateralGrowthBonus from all active agreements (annual).

export_boost_cap.description: Hard cap on cumulative AgreementExportBoost minus 1.0 (e.g. 0.5 = max +50%).

max_concurrent.description: Maximum simultaneous bilateral agreements per country.

spot_market.description: Spot-market trade caps and price-impact (slippage) parameters.

max_single_transaction_usd.description: Base USD cap per single spot transaction. Scaled up per-country by cap_infrastructure_scale x the country's building export bonus (trade ports).

cap_infrastructure_scale.description: Per-transaction cap multiplier growth: effectiveCap = base x (1 + scale x min(BuildingExportBonus, cap_export_bonus_max)). 0 = flat cap for everyone.

cap_export_bonus_max.description: Clamp on the BuildingExportBonus used for cap scaling (one maxed trade port = 0.15).

min_impact_factor.description: Floor on the sell-side price-impact multiplier. Lower = saturated dumping approaches worthless fills (anti get-rich brake); the flat 0.20 default enabled ~20%-of-base bulk extraction.

max_impact_factor.description: Ceiling on the buy-side (overbought) price-impact multiplier: net buying pressure can inflate a resource's quoted price to at most this multiple of its base spot price.

ai_auto_buy_enabled.description: AI countries (no PlayerControlled tag) auto-buy strategic reserve shortfalls on the global spot market when funded. Human players keep their per-resource opt-in toggles.

ai_auto_sell_enabled.description: AI countries auto-sell stockpile surplus on the global spot market (fraction per tick, capped). Human players keep their per-resource opt-in toggles.

auto_sell_min_impact_factor.description: Crash-guard: auto-sell (player and AI) skips a resource while its standing market factor is below this (0.5 = stop dumping once the market is down 50%). 0 disables the guard.

auto_buy_max_impact_factor.description: Realism pass: spike-guard mirror of auto_sell_min_impact_factor — auto-buy skips a resource while its standing market factor exceeds this (2.0 = stop chasing a market pumped 2×). 0 disables.

price_impact_k.description: Slippage strength: sell price x= 1/(1 + k x pressure/supplyProxy). 0 disables slippage.

sell_cap_stockpile_fraction.description: A single spot SELL may always move at least this fraction of the resource's current stockpile (priced at the sell spread), regardless of the coastal trade-port cap — so small/landlocked nations aren't forced into thousands of clicks. 0 disables.

sell_cap_swing_max_usd.description: Absolute USD ceiling on the stockpile-fraction sell floor, so it can't be abused to crash the world market. 0 = country cap only.

auto_buy_treasury_floor_usd.description: Absolute treasury floor (USD) below which strategic-reserve auto-buy is disabled. Effective floor = max(this, revenue_months x MonthlyRevenue, gdp_fraction x GDP). Replaces the old hardcoded $50M.

auto_buy_treasury_floor_revenue_months.description: Relative auto-buy floor: months of MonthlyRevenue to keep in treasury before auto-buy. 0 disables the revenue term.

auto_buy_treasury_floor_gdp_fraction.description: Relative auto-buy floor: fraction of GDP to keep in treasury before auto-buy. 0 disables the GDP term.

trade_hub.description: Commerce niche: small and/or coastal nations earn a trade-hub bonus (extra export/import multipliers + commercial treasury revenue), fading to 0 for large continental powers.

size_reference_provinces.description: Province count at/above which the small-nation trade-hub bonus fades to 0.

base_share.description: Baseline commerce share for a small landlocked nation (no coastline).

coastal_weight.description: Weight of the coastal-province fraction in the commerce term (added to base_share, saturated to 1).

export_bonus_max.description: Max extra export bonus a full trade hub grants, added to BuildingExportBonus before the 0.50 usage cap.

import_discount_max.description: Max extra import discount a full trade hub grants, added to BuildingImportDiscount before the 0.25 usage cap.

commercial_revenue_rate.description: Commercial-hub treasury revenue = hubFactor x rate x monthly export throughput. The real-money lane of the commerce niche.

micro_state_province_threshold.description: Micro-state services floor: countries owning <= this many provinces get a throughput-independent minimum commercial-hub income (tourism/financial services/licensing). 0 disables.

micro_state_services_floor_per_province_.description: Guaranteed services income (USD/month) per owned province for micro-states under the threshold; commercial-hub revenue = max(throughput lane, provinces x this).

resource_strategic_caps.description: Caps applied by ResourceStrategicEffectsSystem to keep deficit consequences bounded.

construction_speed_floor.description: Lowest allowed ConstructionSpeedMultiplier across all stacked deficits.

recruitment_cost_ceiling.description: Highest allowed RecruitmentCostMultiplier across all stacked deficits.

unrest_pressure_monthly_cap.description: Maximum monthly UnrestPressureDelta from all resource deficits combined.

strategic_block_deficit_threshold.description: Deficit ratio at or above which a Strategic resource's strategic_uses are added to BlockedStrategicUses.

diplomacy_tick_interval.description: Diplomacy systems run every N economy ticks (1 = every tick)

relation_decay_rate.description: Monthly relation drift speed toward regional base (points per month)

relation_improve_amount.description: Base relation gain per Improve Relations action

alliance_honor_threshold.description: Minimum relation to honor alliance call to arms

alliance_break_relation_penalty.description: Relation penalty for breaking an alliance (negative value)

alliance_form_min_relation.description: Minimum bilateral relation to form an alliance

war_exhaustion_monthly.description: War exhaustion gained per month while at war

war_exhaustion_depletion_min.description: Minimum depletion factor for dominant nations (e.g. 0.5 = half exhaustion rate when 2:1 stronger)

war_exhaustion_depletion_max.description: Maximum depletion factor for depleted nations (e.g. 3.0 = triple exhaustion rate when 5:1 weaker)

war_exhaustion_reserve_weight.description: How much reserve personnel count toward effective strength (0.5 = half weight)

war_exhaustion_occupation_rate.description: Maximum additive monthly war exhaustion from full occupation of own provinces

war_exhaustion_first_year_dominant_min_m.description: Minimum multiplier applied to base/depletion exhaustion during first-year wars for militarily dominant countries

war_exhaustion_first_year_duration_days.description: Number of in-game days over which dominant first-year exhaustion damping linearly fades to normal

war_exhaustion_first_year_dominant_ratio.description: Own-to-enemy effective military ratio threshold where first-year dominant exhaustion damping begins

war_score_battle_weight.description: Weight of battles won in war score calculation (0-1)

war_score_occupation_weight.description: Weight of provinces occupied in war score calculation (0-1)

war_score_exhaustion_weight.description: Weight of war exhaustion in war score calculation (0-1)

war_score_battle_soft_cap.description: Accumulated battle intensity at which the full battle weight is earned. Intensity 1.0 means an enemy's entire standing army was destroyed, so 4.0 requires destroying it roughly four times over as they rebuild — a sustained campaign, not two won engagements

war_score_enemy_exhaustion_weight.description: Weight of the ENEMY's war exhaustion in this side's war score

war_score_occupation_curve_exponent.description: Concavity applied to the occupied share before weighting. <1 makes early captures worth proportionally more, so the same military achievement scores alike regardless of how finely the victim is subdivided. 1 = linear

war_score_full_occupation_signed_bonus.description: Signed-advantage bonus added when a belligerent holds every enemy province

war_score_winning_threshold.description: Signed war advantage at or above which a country is Winning: drives the UI band and the AI demand gates

war_score_decisive_threshold.description: Signed war advantage at or above which a victory is Decisive (UI band)

war_score_strength_weight.description: War score the STRONGER side earns for military dominance at or beyond the ratio span. Additive and one-sided: the weaker side earns 0, never a penalty. 0 = use the formula default

war_score_strength_ratio_span.description: Side-strength ratio (own / enemy, coalition-aware) at which the full strength weight is earned. 0 = use the formula default

territorial_concession_min_war_score.description: Executable war score at which a belligerent WITHOUT a territorial casus belli may demand provinces it occupies. 0 = use the formula default

territorial_momentum_keep_fraction.description: Fraction of the occupied provinces' total transfer cost that becomes territorial peace-demand budget. 0 = use the formula default

war_score_occupation_ramp_days.description: Days from war start until province occupation reaches its full weight in war score

war_score_collapse_min_days.description: Minimum war duration in days before total-collapse bypass of occupation ramp can activate

war_score_anti_farm_floor.description: Anti-farm MULTIPLIER on the engaged score at zero recorded fighting, scaling to 1.0 at the intensity threshold. Dampens an unfought land grab without erasing it. Replaced an absolute cap whose 0 minimum zeroed genuine occupations and let the occupier read negative. 0 = use the formula default

war_score_anti_farm_intensity_threshold.description: Accumulated battle intensity at which the anti-farm dampener reaches 1.0 (no dampening); below it the multiplier lerps down toward the floor

war_score_enemy_collapse_strength_ratio.description: Side-strength ratio at or above which an enemy counts as hopelessly outmatched, bypassing the anti-farm dampener. Requires the occupation share below as well. 0 = use the formula default

war_score_enemy_collapse_occupation_shar.description: Share of the enemy's provinces that must already be occupied before the outmatched-enemy bypass applies, so it describes this war rather than the two countries' sizes. 0 = use the formula default

war_score_coalition_influence.description: RETIRED, ships at 0. Legacy multiplier on earned war score, superseded by war_score_strength_weight. A multiplier is the wrong shape on an additive scale. 0 here means retired, NOT unset

war_score_coalition_mult_min.description: Lower clamp for the coalition earned-score multiplier

war_score_coalition_mult_max.description: Upper clamp for the coalition earned-score multiplier

war_exhaustion_ally_relief_weight.description: Fraction of friendly-ally strength that relieves the combat war-exhaustion term (small)

peace_coalition_resistance_base.description: Base defensive war-score cushion an allied co-belligerent earns, scaled by combined ally strength

peace_coalition_balance_weight.description: Weight of coalition balance in AI peace accept/hold-out decisions

peace_coalition_resistance_scale.description: Scale converting the coalition resistance cushion (war-score points) into AI give-up resolve (peace-desire reduction per point)

peace_accept_base_threshold.description: Base war score threshold for AI to accept peace deal

province_transfer_min_cost.description: War score cost of the cheapest possible province in a peace deal (small, low-dev/pop)

min_province_demand_budget.description: Minimum executable peace budget before an AI demands any province. Align with province_transfer_min_cost so affordability gates land demands rather than a flat veto. 0 = use the formula default (10).

province_transfer_base_max_cost.description: War score cost ceiling for ordinary (non-mega, non-capital) provinces; the dynamic world-relative score spans [min_cost, base_max_cost]

province_transfer_max_cost.description: Absolute war score cost ceiling, reached only by mega provinces (huge population / world GDP share) and great-power capitals

province_transfer_gdp_weight.description: Weight of the world-relative GDP term in the province transfer cost blend

province_transfer_infra_weight.description: Weight of the world-relative infrastructure term in the province transfer cost blend

province_transfer_pop_weight.description: Weight of the log-scale population term in the province transfer cost blend

province_transfer_gdp_log2_span.description: GDP doublings above/below the world-average province that map to full/zero GDP scaling (log2 span; 6 = 64x)

province_transfer_pop_floor.description: Population at which the population component of province cost begins scaling above the floor

province_transfer_pop_log2_span.description: Number of population doublings above the floor that maps to maximum population scaling (log2 span)

province_transfer_mega_pop_threshold.description: Population at which a province starts counting as mega (cost can exceed base_max_cost)

province_transfer_mega_pop_saturation.description: Population at which the mega population intensity saturates to 1 (cost reaches max_cost)

province_transfer_mega_gdp_share_thresho.description: Share of world province GDP at which a province starts counting as mega

province_transfer_mega_gdp_share_saturat.description: Share of world province GDP at which the mega GDP intensity saturates to 1

province_transfer_capital_min_mega.description: Minimum mega intensity granted to any national capital (premium floor for micro-state capitals)

province_transfer_capital_share_saturati.description: Owning country's share of world GDP at which its capital's mega intensity saturates to 1 (great-power capitals cost max_cost)

province_transfer_full_occupation_discou.description: Cost multiplier applied to province demands when the proposer occupies 100% of the target's provinces (0.75 = 25% cheaper)

full_occupation_peace_budget.description: Peace demand budget granted when the proposer occupies 100% of the target's provinces

truce_duration_months.description: Duration of truce after peace deal in months

sanction_trade_penalty.description: Trade multiplier per active sanction (0.5 = halve trade per sanction)

trade_agreement_bonus.description: Trade multiplier per active trade agreement (1.2 = 20% boost per agreement)

relation_sanction_penalty.description: Relation impact per tick from active sanctions (negative)

relation_trade_agreement_bonus.description: Relation improvement per tick from active trade agreements

ideology_relation_drift.description: Monthly relation delta magnitude from ideological similarity or opposition

leadership_relation_drift.description: Monthly relation delta magnitude from leadership-style similarity or opposition

ethnicity_relation_drift.description: Monthly relation warming when two countries share a dominant ethnicity (one-sided; warms only)

religion_relation_drift.description: Monthly relation warming when two countries share a dominant religion (one-sided; milder than ethnicity)

allied_to_rival_penalty.description: Monthly relation penalty when a target is allied to one of our rivals

allied_to_rival_penalty_defensive_weight.description: Weight applied to allied_to_rival_penalty when the alliance is defensive-only (CollectiveDefense)

allied_to_enemy_penalty.description: Monthly relation penalty when a target is allied to countries we strongly dislike

allied_to_friend_bonus.description: Monthly relation bonus when a target is allied to countries we already trust

hostile_relation_threshold.description: Relation at or below this value counts as hostile for network spillover

friendly_relation_threshold.description: Relation at or above this value counts as friendly for network spillover

max_dynamic_relation_delta.description: Maximum absolute monthly delta produced by dynamic relation logic

alliance_relation_score_weight.description: Utility bonus weight from good relations when evaluating alliance formation

war_relation_hostility_score_weight.description: Utility bonus weight from hostile relations when evaluating war declarations

relation_improve_low_threshold.description: Relations at or below this value receive the low-tier improve multiplier

relation_improve_high_threshold.description: Relations above this value receive the high-tier improve multiplier

relation_improve_low_multiplier.description: Multiplier on improve amount when relation is at or below low threshold (e.g. 1.4 → +7 from base 5)

relation_improve_high_multiplier.description: Multiplier on improve amount when relation is above high threshold (e.g. 0.8 → +4 from base 5)

neutral_zone_threshold.description: Relation range around zero where ideology/leadership drift is dampened

neutral_zone_dampen_factor.description: Fraction of drift to suppress at relation=0 (0.6 = 60% suppression)

peaceful_coexistence_bonus.description: Monthly relation bonus for negative pairs with neutral regional base and no active sanctions. 0 to disable.

improve_relations_mission_rival_multipli.description: Multiplier on Improve Relations mission tick bonus while target is marked as Rival

improve_relations_mission_sanction_multi.description: Multiplier on Improve Relations mission tick bonus while sanctions are active

improve_relations_ceiling_offset.description: Global and mission relation ceiling offset applied above max(regional_base, 0)

technology.description: Technology and research system balance parameters

base_research_speed.description: Base multiplier for research progress per tick (1.0 = normal)

education_research_modifier.description: How much average education level boosts research speed (0-1)

building_research_multiplier.description: Multiplier for building ResearchOutput contribution (1.0 = normal)

max_simultaneous_research.description: Maximum number of technologies a country can research simultaneously

research_points_per_billion_gdp.description: Research points generated per billion USD of research budget

tech_cost_tier_multiplier.description: Cost multiplier per tier above 1 (1.5 = 50% more per tier)

ai_weights.description: AI decision-making utility weights and thresholds

ideology_peace_shield.description: War-utility multiplier for same-bloc nations without a casus belli (0-1; lower = stronger peace, 1 disables)

peace_shield_cb_threshold.description: Casus-belli strength at which the ideological peace shield fully lifts

ethnicity_peace_shield.description: War-utility multiplier for same-dominant-ethnicity nations without a casus belli (0-1; lower = stronger peace, 1 disables)

religion_peace_shield.description: War-utility multiplier for same-dominant-religion nations without a casus belli (0-1; milder than ethnicity, 1 disables)

embargo_deterrent.description: Negative war-utility weight for expected multilateral-sanction trade loss when warring without a casus belli (0 disables)

same_ethnicity.description: Alliance-utility bonus when both countries share a dominant ethnicity

same_religion.description: Alliance-utility bonus when both countries share a dominant religion (milder)

military_force.description: AI force sizing and recruitment affordability gate

war_planning.description: Diplomatic escalation ladder (war-as-last-resort): per-phase durations, readiness gates, military-strength weights and ultimatum response tuning. Phase durations are in days. NOTE: AIWarPlanningSystem steps the ladder QUARTERLY, so a phase cannot advance sooner than the next quarterly tick regardless of the duration set here.

ally_weight_military.description: Fraction of a Military/CollectiveDefense/DefensePact ally's strength counted toward the target's defensive coalition.

ally_weight_political.description: Fraction counted for a Political alignment. Deterrence, not a defence pact — 1.0 here means no AI may attack anything a great power is aligned with.

ally_weight_economic.description: Fraction counted for Economic/TradeAgreement/InternationalOrg ties. Should normally be 0: a trade bloc is not a defensive commitment.

max_events_per_month.description: Maximum events that can fire globally per month tick

mtth_base_modifier.description: Global multiplier for all MTTH values (lower = more frequent events)

moderate_impact_threshold.description: Annual growth-rate-equivalent threshold above which event rarity is moderately increased

major_impact_threshold.description: Annual growth-rate-equivalent threshold above which event rarity is significantly increased

catastrophic_impact_threshold.description: Annual growth-rate-equivalent threshold above which event rarity is heavily increased

moderate_impact_mtth_multiplier.description: MTTH multiplier applied to events at or above the moderate impact threshold

major_impact_mtth_multiplier.description: MTTH multiplier applied to events at or above the major impact threshold

catastrophic_impact_mtth_multiplier.description: MTTH multiplier applied to events at or above the catastrophic impact threshold

event_check_interval_months.description: How often scripted/procedural events are evaluated (1 = every month)

procedural_event_chance.description: Base probability per month for a country to receive a procedural event

cooldown_multiplier.description: Global multiplier for all event cooldown durations

generated_post_event_cooldown_days.description: Post-event cooldown (in days/ticks) applied when scripted or procedural events are queued

reactive_post_event_cooldown_days.description: Post-event cooldown (in days/ticks) applied when reactive events are queued

ai_event_evaluation_threshold.description: Minimum utility score for AI to consider an event option

chain_event_delay_months.description: Default delay before chain events fire (can be overridden per event)

natural_disaster_frequency.description: Multiplier for natural disaster MTTH (lower = more frequent)

max_flags_per_country.description: Maximum event flags per country entity

player_event_auto_decide_days.description: Days before an unanswered player event automatically selects the default option

fog_of_war.description: Fog of war visibility system parameters

enabled.description: Whether fog of war is active

owned_province_vision_radius.description: Vision radius (province hops) from owned provinces

army_vision_radius.description: Vision radius (province hops) from army positions

alliance_sharing_types.description: Alliance types that grant shared vision (Military, DefensePact)

satellite_tier1_vision_bonus.description: Additional vision radius from satellite_constellation tech

satellite_tier2_vision_bonus.description: Additional vision radius from space_surveillance tech

satellite_tier3_vision_bonus.description: Additional vision radius from space_based_radar tech

fog_color_r.description: Red channel of the fog overlay drawn over explored-but-unseen territory (0-1).

fog_color_g.description: Green channel of the fog overlay (0-1).

fog_color_b.description: Blue channel of the fog overlay (0-1).

fog_color_a.description: Opacity of the fog overlay (0-1). Higher hides more of the map underneath.

terra_incognita_color_r.description: Red channel of the unexplored-territory overlay (0-1).

terra_incognita_color_g.description: Green channel of the unexplored-territory overlay (0-1).

terra_incognita_color_b.description: Blue channel of the unexplored-territory overlay (0-1).

explored_desaturation.description: How much to desaturate explored-but-not-visible provinces (0=full color, 1=grayscale)

explored_darken.description: How much to darken explored-but-not-visible provinces (0=full bright, 1=black)

ai_vision_update_interval_ticks.description: How many ticks between AI country vision recalculations

ai_threat_intel_degradation.description: How much to degrade AI threat estimates for unseen countries

coastal_vision_radius.description: Vision radius into sea from owned coastal provinces

initial_neighbor_exploration.description: Whether neighboring provinces of owned territory start as Explored

initial_universal_exploration.description: Whether all sovereign-owned provinces start as Explored for all countries at game start (modern-era intelligence model). Default true.

embassy_vision_radius.description: Vision radius (province hops) around host capital from embassies. Default 1.

trade_agreement_vision.description: Whether active trade agreements maintain Explored visibility of partner territory. Default true.

ally_full_vision_min_relation.description: Minimum bilateral relation for allied vision to grant full Visible (troop-level). Default 50.

ally_explored_min_relation.description: Minimum bilateral relation for allied vision to grant Explored (terrain only). Default 0.

fog_edge_radius_degrees.description: Smooth fog transition zone width in equirectangular degrees for GPU distance field. Default 2.0.

map_interaction.description: Map picking/interaction tunables for micro (sub-pixel) provinces and marker zoom scaling

micro_pick_enabled.description: Enable nearest-centroid pick fallback for micro provinces (Malta, Vatican, ...)

micro_pick_base_radius_px.description: Base screen-space pixel radius for the micro-province pick fallback

micro_pick_min_radius_px.description: Lower clamp on the zoom-scaled micro pick radius (px)

micro_pick_max_radius_px.description: Upper clamp on the zoom-scaled micro pick radius (px)

micro_pick_steal_factor.description: Fraction of the pick radius within which a micro province may steal a click that landed on non-micro land

marker_zoom_min_multiplier.description: Lower clamp on the unit-marker zoom scale multiplier so markers shrink at deep zoom instead of covering micro provinces

satellite.description: Player-deployable reconnaissance satellite parameters (launch, upkeep, vision, globe visuals)

launch_cost.description: One-time treasury cost to launch a satellite

upkeep_per_month.description: Monthly treasury maintenance per active satellite

build_time_months.description: Months from launch order to the satellite reaching orbit

base_vision_radius_hops.description: Base fog-of-war reveal radius (province hops) around the satellite, before tech bonus

max_per_facility.description: Max satellites a country may field per completed satellite_launch_facility

orbital_altitude.description: Height above the globe surface (world units) for the rendered satellite mesh

marker_scale.description: Uniform scale of the satellite mesh on the globe

pick_radius_px.description: Screen-space pixel radius for clicking/selecting a satellite on the globe

move_smoothing.description: Glide rate (per second) the rendered satellite eases toward its target lat/lon when repositioned

ring_color_r.description: Red channel of the satellite orbit ring drawn on the globe (0-1).

ring_color_g.description: Green channel of the satellite orbit ring (0-1).

ring_color_b.description: Blue channel of the satellite orbit ring (0-1).

ring_color_a.description: Opacity of the satellite orbit ring (0-1).

glow_intensity.description: Emissive multiplier applied to the owner-color glow

prewarm_pool_size.description: Number of render entities pre-instantiated into the satellite pool at startup

political_drift.description: Political drift, elections, coups, revolutions, and AI personality modifiers

war_right_shift_per_month.description: Monthly rightward political drift while at war

war_social_authoritarian_shift.description: Monthly authoritarian shift on social axis while at war

peace_moderation_rate.description: Monthly drift toward political center during peacetime

economic_crisis_populist_shift.description: Monthly populist drift during economic crisis

economic_crisis_gdp_growth_threshold.description: GDP growth rate below which economic crisis populist drift triggers (negative value)

regional_influence_weight.description: Weight of neighboring countries ideology on political drift

unrest_extremism_threshold.description: Unrest level above which extremism drift activates

unrest_extremism_shift_rate.description: Monthly extremism drift rate when unrest exceeds threshold

max_drift_magnitude.description: Maximum total political drift magnitude from baseline ideology

spring_back_rate.description: Rate at which ideology springs back toward baseline when drift causes exceed

election_ideology_shift_chance.description: Probability of ideology shift during an election cycle

election_stability_boost.description: Stability boost granted by a successful election

election_cycle_democracy.description: Election cycle length in months for democratic governments

election_cycle_hybrid.description: Election cycle length in months for hybrid regime governments

coup_base_probability.description: Base monthly probability of a coup attempt

coup_stability_threshold.description: Stability below which coups become possible

coup_corruption_weight.description: Weight of corruption in coup probability calculation

coup_military_investment_weight.description: Weight of military investment in coup probability calculation

coup_stability_penalty.description: Stability penalty applied when a coup occurs (negative value)

revolution_base_probability.description: Base monthly probability of a revolution

revolution_unrest_threshold.description: Unrest level above which revolutions become possible

revolution_ideology_distance_weight.description: Weight of ideology distance from population in revolution probability

revolution_stability_penalty.description: Stability penalty applied when a revolution occurs (negative value)

coup_democracy_resilience_multiplier.description: Resilience multiplier applied to coup probability for democratic governments

coup_hybrid_resilience_multiplier.description: Resilience multiplier applied to coup probability for hybrid governments

government_change_cooldown_months.description: Minimum months between any government change events

max_disruptive_changes_per_month.description: Maximum disruptive government changes that can fire globally in a single month; 0 disables the cap

peaceful_transition_stability_threshold.description: Minimum stability for peaceful government transitions to occur

peaceful_transition_corruption_threshold.description: Maximum corruption level for peaceful government transitions

peaceful_transition_probability.description: Monthly probability of peaceful government transition when conditions are met

leader_death_base_probability.description: Base monthly probability of leader death from natural causes

leader_death_war_modifier.description: Multiplier to leader death probability while at war

ai_personality_drift_rate.description: Monthly rate at which AI personality traits drift toward ideology

ai_personality_max_deviation.description: Maximum deviation of AI personality traits from baseline

right_shift_aggression_mod.description: AI aggression modifier from rightward political shift

right_shift_military_mod.description: AI military spending modifier from rightward political shift

right_shift_diplomacy_penalty.description: AI diplomacy penalty from rightward political shift

left_shift_diplomacy_mod.description: AI diplomacy modifier from leftward political shift

left_shift_economic_mod.description: AI economic focus modifier from leftward political shift

left_shift_military_penalty.description: AI military penalty from leftward political shift

extremism_isolationism_mod.description: AI isolationism modifier from political extremism

extremism_alliance_loyalty_penalty.description: AI alliance loyalty penalty from political extremism

law_vote_pass_threshold.description: Parliament support fraction required to pass a national law change

law_support_stance_threshold.description: Bloc stance above which a party votes for a law option (below negative threshold: against)

law_debate_months.description: Months of parliamentary debate before a passed law applies (decrees skip this)

law_decree_resentment.description: ClandestineResentment added when decreeing a law the population fully opposes

law_relation_drift_scale.description: Monthly relation delta per law-affinity dot point between two countries

ai_law_eval_chance.description: Chance an AI attempts one law move on its monthly slot when it wants a change

ai_law_min_support_margin.description: Extra parliament support margin above the pass threshold an AI democracy requires

envoys.description: Strategic Assets / specialist envoy system tunables.

min_specialists_per_country.description: Minimum specialist capacity floor per country.

max_specialists_per_country.description: Maximum specialist capacity ceiling for any country.

capacity_gdp_weight.description: GDP contribution weight for specialist capacity power.

capacity_prestige_weight.description: Prestige contribution weight for specialist capacity power.

capacity_diplomatic_weight.description: Diplomatic-weight contribution weight for specialist capacity power.

capacity_step.description: Composite-power points needed to gain one specialist above floor.

infiltration_duration_days.description: Days an envoy spends in Infiltration phase before auto-advancing to Established.

established_duration_days.description: Days an envoy spends in Established phase before becoming eligible for Deep State.

deep_state_unlock_days.description: Total days deployed (infiltration + established) before Deep State phase unlocks.

exposure_burn_threshold.description: Exposure value at which the envoy is burned (recalled, target gets diplomatic incident).

exposure_decay_per_day_neutral.description: Exposure decay per day while envoy is idle and target is at peace.

exposure_decay_per_day_at_war.description: Exposure decay per day while owner and target are at war (counter-intel scrutiny is higher; usually 0 or negative-effective).

burn_out_relation_penalty.description: Bilateral relation hit applied to owner when an envoy is burned in target.

burn_out_persona_non_grata_days.description: Days the owner is locked out of redeploying any envoy to the same target after a burn (PersonaNonGrata diplomatic state).

recall_cooldown_days.description: Days an envoy is unavailable after voluntary recall before they can be redeployed.

signature_cooldown_days.description: Cooldown on Deep State signature ability per envoy.

recruit_treasury_cost_usd.description: Treasury cost paid to recruit one specialist envoy.

deep_state_required_tech.description: Doctrine gate key (e.g. 'intelligence_t3') required for Deep State phase to unlock for any envoy.

experience_per_successful_op.description: Experience points gained when an envoy contributes to a successful covert op.

experience_per_failed_op.description: Experience points gained when an envoy is involved in a failed (but not detected) op.

trait_unlock_thresholds.description: Experience thresholds at which a new trait roll is offered.

ai_deploy_chance_min.description: Per idle envoy per quarter, the deploy probability for a zero-aggression AI (lerp floor).

ai_deploy_chance_max.description: Per idle envoy per quarter, the deploy probability for a max-aggression AI (lerp ceiling).

ai_hostile_relation_threshold.description: A country must have relation strictly below this for the AI to consider it a hostile envoy target. Must be negative: 0 would make every country with any negative relation a target.

max_incoming_hostile_envoys.description: Cap on how many foreign AI envoys may target the same country simultaneously (anti pile-on).

guarantee.description: Independence guarantees: how long they last, what honouring or breaking one does to prestige and relations.

rivals.description: Declared rivalries: how many are allowed, what they cost, and how they colour relations.

aggressive_expansion.description: Aggressive Expansion (AE) balance settings and decay rates

coalition.description: Coalitions that form against an over-powerful country: size, timing and strength thresholds.

opinion_modifiers.description: How much each remembered action shifts one country's opinion of another.

sphere.description: Spheres of influence: who can lead one, the relations needed to join, and the cost of leaving.

ai_weights.description: Thresholds that decide how readily the AI reaches for these diplomatic tools.

multilateral_sanctions.description: UN-backed sanctions: voting, the economic damage they inflict, and how targets evade them.

trade_blocs.description: Trade blocs: membership limits, the trade and GDP bonuses of joining, and the cost of leaving.

treaties.description: Arms-limitation, non-proliferation, climate and defence treaties: their benefits and the penalty for violating them.

economic_warfare.description: Economic weapons short of war: currency manipulation, trade wars, aid packages and debt traps.

ai_weights.description: Thresholds that decide how readily the AI uses sanctions, blocs, treaties and economic warfare.

game_flow.description: Game flow and save balance parameters

autosave_enabled.description: Whether the game saves itself automatically.

max_save_slots.description: How many save files are kept before the oldest is replaced.

default_player_country.description: Three-letter code of the country pre-selected when starting a new game.

world_order.description: World order and global prestige parameters

g7_gdp_modifier.description: Share added to a G7 member's GDP growth, representing privileged access to capital and markets (0.05 = +5%).

g7_diplomatic_weight.description: Extra diplomatic weight a G7 seat carries when votes and influence are tallied.

g7_prestige.description: Prestige granted for holding a G7 seat.

g20_gdp_modifier.description: Share added to a G20 member's GDP growth (0.02 = +2%).

g20_trade_modifier.description: Share added to a G20 member's trade income (0.02 = +2%).

g20_diplomatic_weight.description: Extra diplomatic weight a G20 seat carries.

g20_prestige.description: Prestige granted for holding a G20 seat.

unsc_p5_prestige.description: Prestige granted to a permanent UN Security Council member.

unsc_p5_diplomatic_weight.description: Extra diplomatic weight a permanent Security Council seat carries, reflecting the veto.

unsc_nonperm_prestige.description: Prestige granted to a non-permanent Security Council member.

unsc_nonperm_diplomatic_weight.description: Extra diplomatic weight a non-permanent Security Council seat carries.

un_member_prestige.description: Prestige granted for plain UN membership.

base_prestige_from_gdp_per_trillion.description: Prestige earned per trillion of GDP, so larger economies carry more weight.

base_prestige_from_military_per_million.description: Prestige earned per million troops fielded.

prestige_decay_rate.description: Share of prestige lost each month, so past glory fades unless it is renewed (0.01 = 1% per month).

veto_relation_penalty.description: Relation change suffered with the country whose resolution you vetoed.
